hero.title: How we work.
hero.subtitle: What we do, the ways you can bring us in, and the principles behind both.

sections.title: Practice
sections.intro: Four disciplines, one team. Most projects move through all four, from working out what to build to keeping it in shape after launch.

items.heading: Consulting & Strategy
items.text: We work out what needs to happen, and what doesn’t. Goals, users, platform and how your team actually works, so you invest in the right thing and everyone knows why.

items.heading: Brand & Story Systems
items.text: Brand, content and digital systems that hold together in practice, not just on paper. Teams move faster, stay consistent, and change course without starting over.

items.heading: Building
items.text: We build fast, accessible, maintainable products and put them into production: websites, design systems, internal tools, AI-assisted workflows. No fragile setups, no handing off to someone else to finish.

items.heading: Looking after it
items.text: After launch we stay close. We watch how it’s used, improve what matters and keep the system from fragmenting, so your investment keeps paying off instead of needing a rebuild.

sections.title: Engagements
sections.intro: Most work starts with a Direction sprint. From there, a fixed-price build, or we stay on as your product direction.

items.heading: Direction sprint
items.label: From €6,500
items.lead: For when you know something needs to change but not yet what to make.
items.text: Week one, with your team and some of your users, we work out what to make and why. Week two, we build a working version with your real content, try it with 3–5 people, and hand over a short plan: what to build, what to leave out, what it costs. If you go on to a Project, the sprint fee comes off its price.

items.heading: Project
items.label: Fixed price
items.lead: For when you need something designed, built and running.
items.text: From brief to launch and into production. Strategy, design, engineering, deployment: one team, no handoff gaps. The price is set in the sprint plan, before any work starts.

items.heading: Advisory
items.label: Fixed monthly fee
items.lead: For teams that need someone senior inside, without a full-time hire.
items.text: One fixed fee a month for one active stream of work, not a count of days. We set the direction, sit with the people who use what we build, work in your stack where it helps, and step back when the system runs on its own. Three months to start, then month to month.

sections.title: Principles
sections.intro: Four principles from the Bauhaus *Vorkurs*, the preliminary course where every student started with materials, form and function.

items.heading: Form follows function
items.text: Every decision is shaped by use, context, and accessibility. Structure comes first.

items.heading: True materials
items.text: Strategy, technology, and content that reflect reality. Built for durability, not short-term appeal.

items.heading: Systems over artifacts
items.text: We don't make one-off deliverables. We make structures that stay consistent as they grow.

items.heading: Close to the problem
items.text: We work where the work happens: with your team, your users and your real data, not from a deck at a distance.
